title: Rav Chama bar Abba

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yevamot 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.62b.11), where Rav Nachman explains his words. In [Pesikta Rabbati, piska “Anokhi Menachemkhem,”](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesikta_Rabbati.33.1) on the verse “And you forgot,” Rabbi Chaggai speaks in the name of R’ Chama bar Abba.[^1]

notes.text: Yevamot names Rav Chama bar Abba or Rabbi Chiyya bar Avin as the speaker on the students’ deaths, and Rav Nachman names the illness. In the linked Pesikta, Rabbi Chaggai speaks in R’ Chama bar Abba’s name.
